name: Nohan
hair: graying, textured hair, dusted with sawdust
build: strong carpenter's build, back bent from decades of labor
wardrobe_baseline: work shirt, canvas work pants, worn steel-toe boots, blue rag on tool belt
role: Carpenter and the last righteous man before the reset

expression_story_mapping.focused: building the ark, a box with stacked rooms, while the block watches
expression_story_mapping.mocked-but-steady: kids throw bottles and old heads shake their heads; he keeps working
expression_story_mapping.obedient: the Voice tells him to build, and he builds without demanding explanation
expression_story_mapping.fearful: sealed inside with his family as the typhoon hits
expression_story_mapping.grieving: listening to the city drown underneath the ark
expression_story_mapping.relieved: stepping onto dry ground after the water recedes
expression_story_mapping.grateful: building an altar before building a house

notes: His family is the only one deemed clean: father Lameko, an unnamed wife, and sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Nohan is a carpenter, not a preacher; he builds the 300-cubit ark and seals every seam with pitch. Animals line up on their own. He survives the flood with his family, carrying grief for the drowned world. His name means rest, comfort; his urban lens is the block's mocked builder, proven right too late for others to board.
